# M3a Wikipedia extraction pilot (auto-generated by `python -m scout.text.wiki_run`)

Commit `7481d17-dirty`, model `claude-haiku-4-5`, prompt `extract-v2`, batch `msgbatch_01JevMwKwG76ffgdnNjgihaB`. Text from Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0); each example links to the exact diff it came from.

- Documents: 100 submitted, 100 succeeded
- Tokens: 141,695 in / 17,079 out (mean 1,417 / 171 per doc); cost **$0.11** (Batch API)
- Events returned: 272; kept after verification: **37**
- Dropped by reason: {'no_quote': 6, 'bad_date': 3, 'year_only': 61, 'outside_window': 157, 'date_not_in_text': 8, 'bad_type': 0}
- Kept by type: {'contract_extension': 10, 'contract_expiry': 5, 'transfer': 18, 'loan': 3, 'injury': 1}

**Full-run estimate:** ~25,540 non-empty documents (all labelled player-years with an English Wikipedia page × the non-empty share in this sample) × measured mean tokens = **$29.00** on the Batch API.

**Sample bias:** the pilot samples only player-years already fetched (the fetcher runs in player-id order, so mostly lower ids, i.e. players who joined Transfermarkt earlier and are older on average).

## Notes added after the run (offline re-verification of the stored outputs; no new API calls)

- **33 of the 100 documents were not labelled snapshots.** The runner took every 1-September revision, including the "previous year" revisions fetched only as diff context (17 of them dated 2012). Fixed in this PR: documents are restricted to labelled snapshot player-years. Wasted spend ≈ $0.04.
- **On the 67 labelled documents:** 157 events returned, **28 kept** (0.42 per player-year). Dropped: outside the window 87, year-only date 31, same-sentence year rule 7, quote not verbatim 4. Kept by type is dominated by transfers and contracts; **injuries are rare** (1 kept in the whole pilot).
- **Refined full-run estimate:** mean 1,300 input / 151 output tokens per labelled document = $0.00103 per document on the Batch API. × ~25,540 non-empty documents ≈ **$26** (the $29 above includes the larger whole-page documents of the unlabelled rows).
- **Sample bias (measured):** fetched players have a median Transfermarkt id of 15,940 vs 168,063 for all mapped players, and a median first snapshot year of 2013 vs 2016. The pilot over-represents 2012–2015 and veteran players.
- **Same-sentence year rule:** it drops 7 of the 35 labelled events that pass every other check (20%). Reading the 8 drops above: 7 look like real events whose year sits earlier in the paragraph or in a season heading. One (Sergio Ramos, claimed April 2020) has no supporting year anywhere nearby and looks like a year the model chose to fit the window, which is exactly what the rule is for.
- **Proposed alternative (not applied; needs approval):** accept the event year if it is written in the quote's sentence, **or** it is the *nearest* year mentioned earlier in the same paragraph of the revision, **or** the nearest preceding section heading names it (a season heading `2016–17` names 2016 and 2017). On the pilot it recovers 6 of the 7 labelled drops and still drops the Ramos case. "Nearest", not "any", so a sentence can't borrow an older year from further up the paragraph; a test would pin that (paragraph "He joined X in 2015. In 2017 he was linked with Y. In January he injured his knee." with a claimed 2015-01 date → dropped).
